title: African Violet Pot
text: African Violet Pot. This is the 3rd style of African Violet pot that I have purchased, on line, and I like it the least of the three.  It takes up a lot of "space", so it isn't the best when you have a "group" of pots.  Also, the interior pot is not a perfect "fit" to the exterior pot.  While it is o.k., there are other pots that are better.

product_metadata.title: 7" Ivory Creme Square African Violet Pot with 3.5 inch Inner Pot
description: This African Violet Pot has a beautiful rich glaze. Each of our African Violet Pots are unique and colors vary from piece to piece, they all make a wonderful addition to any display. 7" African Violet Pots vary between 6 1/2" and 7" depending on the pot shape, and the plant opening is 3 1/2 inches. Each piece is truly a work of art with a glazed outer reservoir leading to a glazed upper ring on the unglazed inner pot. The two parts come apart for cleaning, potting and adding water. These pots are a beautiful choice for African violets, terrestrial orchids, ferns, tropicals and bromeliads too. Dimensions of Outer Pot: 7" Wide 5" Tall Dimensions of Inner Pot: 4.5" Wide 3.25" Tall
